name: Modern Flat
traits: pared-back figures with small heads and long simple limbs
bold colour blocks, almost no shading
generous negative space and editorial layout
bestFor: ads that rely on voice-over and layout more than acting
suits: services, apps and clean consumer goods; calm, trustworthy, contemporary brands
stylePara: Modern flat illustration in motion: pared-back figures with small heads, long simple limbs and no outlines, faces reduced to two dot eyes or left blank; bold blocks of colour from a restrained contemporary palette, one warm accent against soft neutrals and two mid-tones; almost no shading, only an occasional flat darker shape for a shadow or a fold; a subtle fine grain inside the fills; generous negative space; objects simplified to geometric silhouettes; clean, editorial compositions, like an illustrated explainer.

rendering.line: no outlines: shapes meet edge to edge
rendering.shading: almost none; a single flat darker shape for a fold or cast shadow
rendering.colour: restrained palette: soft neutrals, two mid-tones, one warm accent; product colours exact
rendering.texture: fine subtle grain inside the fills, otherwise clean
rendering.lighting: no lighting model: flat colour and contrast carry the hierarchy

motion: Smooth motion-graphics timing: eased transitions, shapes that morph gracefully, characters in simple gestures and loops; limited body acting, emotion carried by posture and colour; overlapping action on hair and plants; nothing jitters.
camera: Flat side or frontal views, slow horizontal pans, scale reveals that pull out to show more of the layout; shape-wipe transitions are added in the edit.
avoid: detailed eyes and mouths appearing mid-shot
fake icons and lettering on screens and posters
sheets: Characters as a flat side, front and three-quarter set with the face formula written in the prompt (two dot eyes, no mouth) and the palette listed; places as one wide editorial composition with plenty of negative space; the product as a simple geometric silhouette in its exact colours.
risk: Minimal faces are the point, but Seedance fills them in with eyes and mouths after a few seconds and adds gradients. Write 'faces stay minimal: two dot eyes, no mouth' in STYLE and the CAST RULE. Acting is limited, so put the emotional turn in posture, framing and the colour accent rather than expressions.

example.prompt: Modern flat illustration still: a pared-back woman in her thirties with a small head, two dot eyes, a dark bun and long simple limbs in an orange top holds a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap, standing in a sunny kitchen reduced to soft neutral colour blocks; a droopy fern of simple geometric leaves sags on the windowsill; no outlines, almost no shading, one flat shadow shape, subtle grain, generous negative space, editorial composition. Vertical 9:16. No text.
